Appalachian State Mountaineers.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the whole room was rebuilt through the portal and the guide names no winner.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.previous_school: Malachi Singleton from Purdue; Henry Hasselbeck from UCLA; Tommy Ulatowski from Kent State.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.career_experience: Not addressed in guide for any of the three. It confirms Hasselbeck is Matt's son and that Loggains coached with Matt at the Titans in the early 2010s.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide's analytical case is that Hasselbeck and Singleton are more mobile than last year's options.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.efficiency: Team-level only: the offense managed 5.4 yards per play and 24.2 PPG, against a historical benchmark of at least six yards per play in essentially every season since App State joined the Sun Belt.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.competition: Open among three portal additions — Malachi Singleton, Henry Hasselbeck and Tommy Ulatowski — with the guide naming no favourite.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.backup: The three named candidates are Singleton, Hasselbeck and Ulatowski.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.author_confidence: Positive about the group without endorsing an individual. The guide reads last season's usage as a verdict on the previous room — AJ Swann and JJ Kohl attempted nearly the same number of passes and three other quarterbacks took reps, which it calls fair evidence Loggains was not enamoured with any of them.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.positive_case: Mobility. Hasselbeck and Singleton are more mobile than last year's options and should add explosiveness, and the guide states outright that it believes the offense will be better and that a more dual-threat quarterback may be a game-changer.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.concerns: No established starter, and a wave of new faces at receiver and running back alongside a new scheme.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.scheme_fit: The guide expects the pace to rise, noting new coordinator Mike Anthony was an assistant under Kendal Briles at multiple stops, and flags a structural edge — App State plays at the highest elevation east of the Mississippi River in FBS, which makes sense to exploit if the offense can play fast enough.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.supporting_cast: New but promising. Named potential explosive-play sources are Ja'Quez Cross from Arkansas State and Chris Lofton from Gardner-Webb; the rest is highly touted recruits looking for a fresh start, JUCO transfers and Year 1 holdovers. Its conditional conclusion: if the offense runs with tempo, the improved depth at the skill positions is promising.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.portal_context: Per 247Sports, App State signed the second-ranked transfer portal class — including several new quarterback options — plus the top freshman class in the conference.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 6.5 wins, flagged explicitly as an alt win total since 5.5 with heavy Over juice is the prevailing number. The guide also suggests 18-1 to win the conference is worth some thought, and notes App State hosts both Old Dominion and James Madison while avoiding Louisiana and Troy. Projection is 5.67 wins, with a stated belief the team can overachieve.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.outlook_dependency: High. The guide's stated belief that the offense will be better runs through a more dual-threat quarterback being a game-changer.
Appalachian State Mountaineers.conflicts: The guide names three portal quarterbacks and declines to state an expected starter, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Arkansas State Red Wolves.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the guide expects the competition to take time and lists four candidates without choosing.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.previous_school: Trey Owens from Texas; Drew Dickey and Jeremy St-Hilaire from Vanderbilt; Ethan Crawford is the holdover.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.career_experience: Crawford did not play last season; Owens was a four-star Texas prospect who never saw the field; Dickey and St-Hilaire sat behind Diego Pavia at Vanderbilt. The guide's summary is essentially zero experience on the roster.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.passing: Not addressed in guide for any candidate. Departing starter Jaylen Raynor posted a career-best 3,361 passing yards on a Sun Belt-leading 501 attempts.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.rushing: Not addressed in guide for any candidate; Raynor managed 2.7 yards per carry.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.efficiency: Not addressed in guide for any candidate.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.turnovers: Not addressed in guide for any candidate; team-level, Arkansas State posted a -7 turnover margin.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.competition: Open among Ethan Crawford, Trey Owens, Drew Dickey and Jeremy St-Hilaire, with the guide giving a distinct reason to believe in each: the ex-Commodores already know Altman's philosophy, Owens probably has the most untapped upside, and Crawford knows the returning skill players.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.backup: The four named candidates are Crawford, Owens, Dickey and St-Hilaire.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.author_confidence: Low on identity, positive on the offense. The guide expects the competition to take time while concluding Altman may well create a much more explosive offense.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.positive_case: Coordinator Garrett Altman's pedigree — still playing at TCU a decade ago, an analyst at New Mexico State when Pavia was there and therefore instrumental in every phase of that quarterback's development, with Vanderbilt leading the nation at 7.47 yards per play last season.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.concerns: Essentially zero experience on the roster, and the loss of all-time leading receiver Corey Rucker alongside the quarterback.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.scheme_fit: A fresh installation is going in anyway with Altman's arrival, and two of the candidates already know his philosophy.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.supporting_cast: Reasonable. Top rushers Devin Spencer and Kenyon Clay return, plus 5-foot-6 receiver Chauncy Cobb, who had 73 catches last season.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.portal_context: Dickey and St-Hilaire followed Altman's system from Vanderbilt; Owens arrives from Texas.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 5.5 wins, though the guide reframes the question — the vig is heavy on 5.5, so the better question is whether to venture Over 6.5. It prefers a different market entirely, betting Over the game total weekly, with an explicit timing argument: if a quarterback emerges the books will catch up, but if Altman picks the right player from the outset there is an edge before the market adjusts. Projection is 6.36 wins.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.outlook_dependency: High. The guide's preferred market position is constructed around the timing of the quarterback resolution relative to the books.
Arkansas State Red Wolves.conflicts: The guide names four candidates and declines to state an expected starter, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.status: Transfer — from Missouri State, following head coach Ryan Beard.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.career_experience: Jacob Clark's backup at Missouri State, who got his chance when Clark was hurt.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide's comparison is to a dual-threat profile.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.competition: Live. Other options are Trever Jackson from Arkansas and JUCO transfer Tre Guerra, whose offer list the guide gives as Texas Tech, Kentucky, Florida State, LSU and Virginia.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.author_confidence: Positive about the group rather than the individual: the guide's overall verdict is that the talent level at the position looks a lot better.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.positive_case: Beard's familiarity with Bailey is treated as an advantage, and the guide's comparison is to Samari Collier, who injected a major spark into the Coastal offense last season — a dual-threat at six yards per carry who led the team to over 40 PPG before getting hurt. It observes that a dual-threat quarterback looks like a luxury in this conference.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.concerns: None of the current quarterback options are experienced at this level, and the guide expects negative plays from sacks to be a real worry.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.scheme_fit: Beard brought his coordinators with him, which the guide credits as sideline continuity, and Bailey already knows the staff.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.supporting_cast: The guide's biggest worry. Its warning comes from Missouri State's numbers: even with a very experienced quarterback, Clark was sacked 48 times and the team allowed 52 sacks overall, while the Bears managed just 3.5 yards per carry. On the line itself: a girthy group of very big bodies, but none who have played together, and only Daughtry Richardson was a high-ranked recruit. It calls this easily the most questionable position group.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.portal_context: Roughly 60 new players including a conference-high 42 transfers per 247Sports. The guide notes all the quarterbacks Beard brought in, and virtually all the skill players, have eligibility beyond this season.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins, argued as a timing question rather than a talent one: this season is about building for next season, with eligibility the supporting evidence. Projection is 4.86 wins.
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Under is argued from the scale of the rebuild and forward-looking eligibility rather than from quarterback quality, which it rates improved.

Georgia Southern Eagles.status: Transfer — a much-travelled veteran in his final year of eligibility, replacing all-time leading passer JC French.
Georgia Southern Eagles.previous_school: LSU, Texas A&M and North Carolina across seven seasons.
Georgia Southern Eagles.career_experience: Seven seasons at LSU, Texas A&M and North Carolina.
Georgia Southern Eagles.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Georgia Southern Eagles.passing: Not addressed in guide. The benchmark it sets is Kyle Vantrease, third on the programme list with 4,253 yards from one season in 2022, with departing starter JC French leading at 5,882.
Georgia Southern Eagles.competition: None described — Johnson is presented as the starter.
Georgia Southern Eagles.author_confidence: Positive. The guide presents him as capable of a Vantrease-like season or better and says he has a chance at a massive season in his final year of eligibility.
Georgia Southern Eagles.positive_case: The guide notes the obvious joke about his longevity, then makes the serious point that schools keep paying him to come. It adds context that Helton moved the Eagles from an option offense to a spread, which has produced productive quarterback play in relative terms.
Georgia Southern Eagles.concerns: The top five pass-catchers are gone, including 1,000-yard receiver Camden Brown, now with the Cowboys.
Georgia Southern Eagles.scheme_fit: The spread Helton installed has produced productive quarterback play in relative terms; the guide argues the scheme itself will produce numbers.
Georgia Southern Eagles.supporting_cast: Rebuilt. Marcus Sanders and Dalen Cobb combined for 107 catches and eight touchdowns and are gone, as is Camden Brown, who had 65 catches with 14 going for scores. Candidates named are 6-foot-5 Ashton Hollis from Illinois and Andre Greene, a highly touted recruit who did little at Virginia, plus Josh Dallas and River Helms, both back after being lost early last season. Its conclusion is that the WR1 may be unknown but many players can put up statistics in this offense, especially with Johnson throwing.
Georgia Southern Eagles.portal_context: Johnson, Hollis and Greene all arrived through the portal; JC French left for Cincinnati.
Georgia Southern Eagles.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 4.5 wins, described as tough: the price is juicy, but six wins is a challenge given the schedule. Its conclusion is bullish anyway — a really high ceiling, possibly higher than anyone expects if Mutz can fix the defense — and it calls this one of its biggest overlays, with a projection of 5.49 wins putting the alt Over 5.5 in play.
Georgia Southern Eagles.outlook_dependency: High. The guide frames the defense as the swing factor precisely because the offensive upside with a very experienced quarterback is already assumed.

Georgia State Panthers.status: Returning starter — the guide says he is and was clearly the best option.
Georgia State Panthers.career_experience: Established as the best of three quarterbacks used last season.
Georgia State Panthers.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count; the guide notes he did not start the team's best loss, 14-7 to CFP participant James Madison.
Georgia State Panthers.passing: A 13-to-1 touchdown-to-interception ratio. The Panthers lost all three games in which he passed for 200-plus yards, averaging just 25 PPG in them while the defense allowed 41, 41 and 38 points.
Georgia State Panthers.rushing: 61 carries for 284 yards at 4.7 per carry with four rushing scores.
Georgia State Panthers.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a completion rate.
Georgia State Panthers.turnovers: One interception against 13 touchdown passes — set against TJ Finley and Christian Veilleux combining for a 9-to-10 ratio and forming a big part of a -11 team turnover margin.
Georgia State Panthers.competition: None described — Brown is the settled starter.
Georgia State Panthers.author_confidence: Positive on the player, pessimistic about what it changes. The guide notes that even when he played well it did not seem to matter.
Georgia State Panthers.positive_case: A 13-to-1 ratio with genuine rushing production, and the guide's logic that he should theoretically help the defense if he repeats his 2025 form.
Georgia State Panthers.concerns: He has lost 1,000-yard receiver Ted Hurst and leading rusher Jordon Simmons, who averaged 5.6 yards per carry, and the guide's evidence is that good quarterback play did not translate into results.
Georgia State Panthers.scheme_fit: Offensive coordinator Hue Jackson is back.
Georgia State Panthers.supporting_cast: Weak and specifically undersized. All the running backs are under six feet, and leading returning receiver Grant Hollier, one of the few big bodies, had just 21 catches. Power Four offensive line transfers arrived from Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Georgia Tech and Oklahoma State, with the qualification that they played sparingly or not at all, plus four-star freshman lineman Maxwell Robinson.
Georgia State Panthers.portal_context: Power Four offensive line transfers who played sparingly or not at all; the guide's structural conclusion is that a coach like McGee makes sense on paper but lacks the big NIL budget that this kind of head coach requires.
Georgia State Panthers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 3.5 wins, noted as an alt win total available at a plus-money price. The guide's reasoning separates the roles — McGee has not proven to be a college-level head coach — and adds the market evidence that the team is 5-18-1 ATS over the past two seasons. Projection is 3.63 wins.
Georgia State Panthers.outlook_dependency: Low. The guide's evidence is precisely that the quarterback played well without changing outcomes; its Under rests on the coach, the roster and the schedule.

James Madison Dukes.status: New starter — a 6-foot-5 sophomore promoted from within after two years learning behind Alonza Barnett.
James Madison Dukes.career_experience: Spent two years learning behind Barnett; not a highly sought recruit.
James Madison Dukes.competition: None described — Evans is presented as the choice, with UCF transfer Davi Belfort the only portal addition at the position and one who barely played.
James Madison Dukes.backup: UCF transfer Davi Belfort, who barely played.
James Madison Dukes.author_confidence: Cautious. The guide calls the quarterback position a major question mark and puts the biggest question to Billy Napier as who plays there and whether that player can match the predecessors' success.
James Madison Dukes.positive_case: The support structure is the argument for him — returning running back George Pettaway plus transfer Nick Herman, who averaged over seven yards per carry at Drake, meaning a run-heavy approach could keep early pressure off him, with an offensive line suited to running the ball. It adds a coaching data point: Michigan State was not great last season, but its quarterbacks posted a 20/6 ratio, and pass game coordinator Aaron Pflugrad is the Dukes' new quarterbacks coach.
James Madison Dukes.concerns: No track record, replacing a line of successful predecessors — Jordan McCloud and Alonza Barnett upheld the programme's standards even through the FCS-to-FBS transition.
James Madison Dukes.scheme_fit: Favourable. New coordinator Cam Aiken is called a rising star — a Clemson graduate on staff for two National Championships, then time under Lane Kiffin at Ole Miss, then East Tennessee State, where the Buccaneers scored over 32 PPG with better than 440 yards per game. The guide calls it an outstanding hire.
James Madison Dukes.supporting_cast: Good in the run game. George Pettaway returns and Nick Herman arrives from Drake, behind a line suited to running the ball; the offense averaged 6.4 yards per play and 37.1 PPG last season.
James Madison Dukes.portal_context: The guide explains the roster mechanism: with NIL funds allocated elsewhere, the Dukes essentially did not take the portal route at quarterback. 247Sports graded the overall haul best in the conference by a wide margin, while the guide cautions many additions come from lower divisions, FCS, or Power Four programmes where they never saw the field.
James Madison Dukes.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 8.5 wins, with the quarterback position named a major question mark. The precedent it leans on is Chesney's first regular season producing 8-4. A rest angle is spelled out — 11 straight weeks without a break — plus a tricky road slate. Projection is 8.91 wins.
James Madison Dukes.outlook_dependency: Very high. The quarterback question is the guide's stated reason for taking the Under despite a projection above the number.

Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.status: Returning starter — the guide notes the job is officially his now.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.career_experience: Lost out to Walker Howard at the start of last season, then split time with Daniel Beale once Howard was hurt, before leading a four-game winning streak to reach a bowl.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.rushing: 667 rushing yards and nine rushing touchdowns.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.efficiency: 58.8% completions — the guide calls him a mediocre-at-best passer.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.competition: Resolved — the guide says the job is officially his now.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.backup: Daniel Beale is named as the player he split time with last season.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.author_confidence: Split by skill. The guide's assessment is a mediocre-at-best passer but a genuine runner, and it suggests the clarity of having the job may help.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.positive_case: He led a four-game winning streak to reach a bowl, is a genuine runner, and coordinator Tim Leger can now scheme the offense exclusively around him.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.concerns: Passing quality, and how narrow last season's run was — three of those four wins came by four points or fewer, as did four of the team's five conference wins.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.scheme_fit: Favourable in intent — the guide says Leger can now scheme the offense exclusively around him.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.supporting_cast: Built to run. The guide says this is a big offensive line group and the plan is plainly to run the ball as much as possible, with the supporting evidence that Louisiana had only one game with 30 pass attempts in conference play last season, making the health of the run-blockers paramount. That line was battered last season, with three players suffering long-term injuries early.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.portal_context: The fewest portal additions in the conference, which the guide names as its central worry, offering two possible explanations: either there is not much money there, or nobody is willing to invest it.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 7.5 wins. The guide states it does not know that things are working with Desormeaux and that the athletic department may face a big decision. Its central worry is the complete lack of portal involvement while other conference programmes improve externally. Projection is 7.25 wins.
Louisiana Ragin’ Cajuns.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Under is argued from the coach's trajectory and roster building rather than from the quarterback, whose role it treats as now settled.
